༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi bum sgrub bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// spyan ras gzigs kyi bum sgrub bzhugs so//

༄༅// spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas ril bu sgrub na/ rgyas par dkyil 'khor bcas/ de'i dbus su ril bus gang ba'i bum pa bzhag mtha' mchod pas bskor/ bdag bskyed rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor yod na der lha bskyed/ bum pa rin po che sna lnga las grub pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsgom/ de'i nang du bum rdzas kyi ril bu rnams hrīḥdakar po la/ hrīḥsngo ser dmar ljang gis bskor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus/ yongs su gyur pa las padma sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rigs lnga spyan ras gzigs thams cad zhi ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa shel 'phreng*/ g.yon gnyis pa padma rang rang gi mdog mthun bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying khar hūm̐ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil bas rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ mchod bstod/ de nas sngags bgrang ba'i dus sngags 'phreng bdag gi thugs ka nas gzungs thag la 'khril te/ bum nang gi rigs lnga la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul te sku las 'od zer gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las mdzad pas sems can thams cad thul te spyan ras gzigs su song*/ slar 'dus sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas bsdus nas rang rang la thim/ thun 'jog kar bum nang gi lha rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsir stem stem zhu khol zhing lud par bsam mo// spyan ras gzigs kyi bum sgrub 'khyer bde ba me rag mdo pa'i/
spyi bla sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba'i ngor// padma dkar pos 'brug chos sdings su sbyar ba'o// maṅgalaṃ/// /
